correctness.rationale: A unique diagonal-antidiagonal incidence gives normalized cross-Gram entries. The two parity blocks converge in S2 to the same reflection-symmetric integral kernel: a uniform O(delta) boundary-tail bound and bounded interior dominated convergence justify it. Folding yields a weighted Volterra operator. Explicit complete hypergeometric-polynomial eigenfunctions give singular values 1/k. Two blocks provide the doubled law; S2 convergence supplies the total squared-sum pi^2/3 and full l2 convergence. The finite projection angle equality proves sharp c_n=1-s_3, tending to 1/2. Independent supplemental finite checker passed 43,864 finite assertions.

value.rationale: The motivator algebraically identifies the nonunique two-dimensional Toeplitz/Hankel intersection but leaves numerical stability unresolved. The new result identifies all limiting canonical correlations, supplies a sharp dimension-asymptotic stability constant 1/2, and an explicit spectral bridge to a weighted Volterra operator. This is a motivated structural metric invariant rather than a routine special case or arbitrary numerical slice.
